{
  "cases": [
    {
      "id": "sp01-01",
      "family_id": "special-fam-01-standard-country-count",
      "task": "01",
      "category": "standard",
      "input": "How many customers are from France?",
      "canonical_input": "How many customers are from France?",
      "scope": { "route": "sql", "db_id": "chinook", "doc_ids": [] },
      "history": [],
      "expected_behavior": "直接执行；按 customer.country 等值过滤统计客户数。",
      "allowed_interpretations": ["按客户居住国 France 统计 customer 行数"],
      "expected_bindings": [
        { "column": "customer.country", "operator": "=", "value": "France", "surface": "France" }
      ],
      "missing_conditions": [],
      "business_basis": [
        "schema: customer.country 为客户所在地",
        "live_database_facts.countries 含 France",
        "confirmed_business_rules.general.region: 客户所在地 customer.country 与账单地址 invoice.billing_country 保留各自含义"
      ],
      "reference_intent": {
        "task_type": "count",
        "metric": "COUNT(*)",
        "filters": [ { "column": "customer.country", "operator": "=", "value": "France" } ],
        "time_scope": null,
        "grouping": null,
        "top_n": null
      },
      "gold_sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM public.customer WHERE country = 'France';",
      "controller": null,
      "secondary_tags": [],
      "case_style": "natural"
    },
    {
      "id": "sp01-02",
      "family_id": "special-fam-02-alias-approved-artist",
      "task": "01",
      "category": "alias",
      "input": "Iron Maiden乐队一共有多少张专辑？",
      "canonical_input": "Iron Maiden乐队一共有多少张专辑？",
      "scope": { "route": "sql", "db_id": "chinook", "doc_ids": [] },
      "history": [],
      "expected_behavior": "有限改写；approved 别名唯一绑定 artist.name='Iron Maiden'，统计其专辑数。",
      "allowed_interpretations": ["统计 artist.name = 'Iron Maiden' 的 album 行数"],
      "expected_bindings": [
        { "column": "artist.name", "operator": "=", "value": "Iron Maiden", "surface": "Iron Maiden乐队" }
      ],
      "missing_conditions": [],
      "business_basis": [
        "approved_aliases: Iron Maiden乐队 -> Iron Maiden, review_status=approved",
        "live_database_facts.named_artist_values: artist_id=90 name='Iron Maiden'",
        "schema: album.artist_id FK -> artist.artist_id"
      ],
      "reference_intent": {
        "task_type": "count",
        "metric": "COUNT(*)",
        "filters": [ { "column": "artist.name", "operator": "=", "value": "Iron Maiden" } ],
        "time_scope": null,
        "grouping": "artist",
        "top_n": null
      },
      "gold_sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS album_count FROM public.album a JOIN public.artist ar ON a.artist_id = ar.artist_id WHERE ar.name = 'Iron Maiden';",
      "controller": null,
      "secondary_tags": ["approved_alias"],
      "case_style": "natural"
    },
    {
      "id": "sp01-03",
      "family_id": "special-fam-03-alias-approved-country",
      "task": "01",
      "category": "alias",
      "input": "德国的发票一共开了多少钱？",
      "canonical_input": "德国的发票一共开了多少钱？",
      "scope": { "route": "sql", "db_id": "chinook", "doc_ids": [] },
      "history": [],
      "expected_behavior": "有限改写；approved 别名唯一绑定 customer.country='Germany'，按发票粒度 SUM(invoice.total)。",
      "allowed_interpretations": ["按客户所在地 Germany 汇总发票总额"],
      "expected_bindings": [
        { "column": "customer.country", "operator": "=", "value": "Germany", "surface": "德国" }
      ],
      "missing_conditions": [],
      "business_basis": [
        "approved_aliases: 德国 -> Germany, column=customer.country, review_status=approved",
        "confirmed_business_rules.metrics.sales_revenue: 发票粒度 SUM(invoice.total)",
        "confirmed_business_rules.general.region: customer.country 是客户所在地"
      ],
      "reference_intent": {
        "task_type": "sum",
        "metric": "SUM(invoice.total)",
        "filters": [ { "column": "customer.country", "operator": "=", "value": "Germany" } ],
        "time_scope": null,
        "grouping": null,
        "top_n": null
      },
      "gold_sql": "SELECT SUM(i.total) AS revenue FROM public.invoice i JOIN public.customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'Germany';",
      "controller": null,
      "secondary_tags": ["approved_alias"],
      "case_style": "natural"
    },
    {

      "gold_sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM public.customer WHERE country = 'France';",
      "controller": null,
      "secondary_tags": ["typo"],
      "case_style": "natural"

    {
      "id": "sp01-05",

      "category": "typo",
      "input": "Metallcia 有多少张专辑？",

      "allowed_interpretations": ["统计 artist.name = 'Metallica' 的专辑数"],
      "expected_bindings": [
        { "column": "artist.name", "operator": "=", "value": "Metallica", "surface": "Metallcia" }

      "business_basis": [

      "reference_intent": {
        "task_type": "count",
        "metric": "COUNT(*)",

      "gold_sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS album_count FROM public.album a JOIN public.artist ar ON a.artist_id = ar.artist_id WHERE ar.name = 'Metallica';",

      "case_style": "natural"
    }
  ],
  "notes": [
    "本批 5 条均为项目自编 dev 合成数据，非官方或保留集。",

  ]
